the model says the meaning changed: The change rewrites how the judge question quotes an older record's words and date, and when it says none were found. The code now searches the transcripts itself instead of trusting the judge's quote, so what EX-1 and EX-2 rely on is altered.; brought to the owner as a card: What you asked for: iaso approves a record for you only when it is sure what you meant. Otherwise it asks you, and a match in your past sessions is never enough to approve on its own. The requirement agrees with this. It says that for an older record iaso never logged, iaso looks for your words in this project's past sessions. The question you get then quotes those words with their date, or says none were found and asks what you meant.

What changed: before, the judge model had to supply the quote, and a question without one was held back. Now iaso runs the search itself and adds the quote and the day (for example "4 Oct") to the question. It does this even when the model gave no quote. If the model's quote can't be found anywhere, iaso drops it. For an older record, iaso then adds "I found none of your words about this in your past sessions." The change also does other things:
- A question that names no records now applies to every record its review job looked at.
- A question you already answered is dropped.
- Longer headers lose whole words from the end instead of being cut mid-word.

What's unclear: none of this clearly breaks one of the requirement's examples. The day is still quoted, a miss is still reported, and nothing gets approved just because of a match. But the requirement says the judge model's question supplies the quote, and now iaso does. A quote the model gives that iaso can't find also disappears without a word. The code points to two of your decisions (one says a quote is optional), so this was probably on purpose. The prompt of the turn that likely made the change was empty, though, so I can't confirm you asked for it.; the card is not offered until it is complete, it lacks: what option 1 ("Keep the change and reword the requirement: iaso itself searches your past sessions and adds the quote and its date to the question, or says nothing was found") does and leaves undone; what option 2 ("Keep the change, but show the model's quote even when iaso can't find it in your sessions") does and leaves undone; what option 3 ("Undo the change: the judge model must give the quote and date itself, and a question without one is held back") does and leaves undone; why the recommended option is recommended (iaso stale card SR-249#3 --consequences "..." --why "...")
